notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
You control at least one additional creature.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature, you may instead use Xavier Sal's first ability to get infinite copies of creature tokens you control.
